supported_behavior: The explicit Japanese header 計算手順を実行して: accepts 1..16 lines in step-id: expression form; IDs are unique ASCII identifiers and each expression is limited to 8192 bytes.
A step can reference only earlier steps using @{step-id}; each reference becomes a parenthesized canonical exact dimensionless rational from the actual prior calculation artifact.
The Core scheduler declares each step as a required computed-value node and consumes the exact artifact hashes for declared prerequisites before observing the new result.

Per-step immutable artifacts retain input source byte spans, evaluated expressions, calculation records and each consumed occurrence; a sequence report links all step artifact hashes and the final exact value.
The existing finite task action budget includes all sequence graph nodes; the parser rejects forward/unknown references, duplicate IDs and malformed sequence lines before calculation.
known_limits: Unit-bearing results cannot be substituted as dimensionless rational values.
The expression language remains the existing bounded exact arithmetic grammar; this does not establish general symbolic or natural-language multi-step reasoning.
No runtime, CLI, test or independent task-quality observation accompanies this source/build slice.
